text:
maria: Heads-up — after a handful of spot preemptions today some pods on fractional-GPU nodepool are stuck 'Terminating' and CA isn't replacing nodes fast enough. We end up with 0.5-2m reduced capacity.
chris: Which nodepool? fractional-gpu-eu? logs?
lee: saw this in us-west too earlier.
maria: fractional-gpu-pool-us-west. example pod:
```
NAME: ml-worker-42
STATUS: Terminating (stuck)
REASON: NodeShutdown
TerminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
```
sam: CA events? infra-bot?
infra-bot: [cluster-autoscaler] 1976543220 scaleUp: triggered for nodepool/fractional-gpu-pool-us-west (insufficient resources: pods requiring nvidia.com/gpu)
chris: CA policy is conservative: scaleUpDelay=0s but scaleDownUnneededTime=10m. The issue is kubelet waits for gracePeriod then marks the node NotReady; CA needs the new node to appear — but preemptions create many Terminating pods.
lee: fractional sharing + MIG/time-slice makes preemption partial; pod eviction interacts badly with PDBs (PodDisruptionBudget). If PDB blocks eviction, CA can't kill to make room.
maria: suggestion: increase kubelet's 'eviction-hard' thresholds? or bump TerminationGracePeriodSeconds to 120 so pods terminate cleanly and CA sees capacity sooner?
sam: increasing grace may delay reclaim. We should instead set evictionAttack: reduce TerminationGracePeriod and use terminationGracePeriodSeconds on pods that can checkpoint quickly.
chris: Another lever: make fractional GPU nodepool have a shorter 'scaleDownDelayAfterAdd' and set CA expander to 'random' or 'least-waste'?
lee: We also could add a 'preemption-proxy' DaemonSet that watches for preemptions and force-drains pods faster, unblocking MIG slices.
maria: short-term fix: add toleration+priorityClass to low-priority batch jobs so they preempt first and free up full GPU slices. Also reduce PDB for training jobs.
sam: can we change node labels/taints per slice size so CA prefers to spin up full-GPU nodes for heavy jobs and fractional nodes for bursts?
chris: action items:
- sam: add a cluster-autoscaler alert when >3 Terminating pods on fractional pool >1m (sam)
- lee: prototype preemption-proxy (lee)
- maria: update PDBs for training jobs and add priorityClass doc (maria)

maria: anyone opposed to trying that today? :eyes:
lee: +1
sam: +1, but schedule a rollback if we see scale churn
chris: I'll adjust CA alert and share patch in infra repo.
infra-bot: deploy queued: infra/ca-alerts#42 by chris
maria: thanks all, will monitor. :thumbsup:
